The tournament finished on 30. November with Milton, Sickness, Viag, Slaughter and FinalExit in the winning team: Milton's Unholy Horde of Chaos and Darkness taking first spot; going on a 20 maps winning streak! === Format === * Round robin system ** 8 teams, 5 players' per team ** Every match is {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} * Playoffs with top four teams ** Playoffs is {{Abbr|BO5|Best of 5}} It's the responsibility of the teams to do /f_ruleset checks and /f_modified checks. It's expected that everyone should play with correct ruleset, client and pass modified checks.
